title: Regularity for solutions to inhomogeneous degenerate parabolic $p$-Laplace equations
summary: For weak solutions to quasilinear degenerate parabolic equations of $p$-Laplace type, a central obstacle in applying the method of intrinsic scaling to prove their Hölder regularity is the derivation of forward-in-time propagation estimate for the spatial measure of level sets. In this paper, we revisit and overcome this difficulty for an inhomogeneous degenerate parabolic $p$-Laplace equation with bounded nonnegative time-independent forcing term and initial data.
